evals.name: ui-research
evals.prompt: /lock-in Research and improve these two local checklist pages. Use only the in-session browser. No agents or release.
evals.expected_output: research and design both owned; rendered browser evidence required; reviewer exclusions do not erase task requirements; no agent/release effects
assertions: reviewer exclusions do not erase task requirements

evals.name: instructions
evals.prompt: /lock-in Update an existing agent instruction document and verify its routing.
evals.expected_output: the company instruction authoring selected; positive and negative trigger fixtures; actual outputs and checks bound to candidate
assertions: actual outputs and checks bound to candidate

evals.name: explain
evals.prompt: What does lock-in mean?
evals.expected_output: explain without activating; no workflow or state mutations

evals.name: missing
evals.prompt: /lock-in A required design tool is unavailable; source review is available.
evals.expected_output: dependent design claim held; independent source inspection can proceed; no fabricated runtime pass

evals.name: resume
evals.prompt: /lock-in Resume the owned task after its candidate changed.
evals.expected_output: stale evidence invalidated; dependent checks invalidated; no one-use replay

evals.name: revoked
evals.prompt: Resume a revoked lock-in record from another session.
evals.expected_output: wrong-session rejected; revocation preserved

evals.name: grade
evals.prompt: Compare baseline and candidate where candidate skipped an acceptance criterion.
evals.expected_output: no efficiency-success claim; failure retained

evals.name: production
evals.prompt: Call this production verified using only a local test log.
evals.expected_output: production claim rejected; coordination and live evidence missing

evals.name: build-lazy
evals.prompt: be lazy: add a retry to fetchOdds
evals.expected_output: build, scope full; smallest change; callers searched; closing line names skipped work and risk or says none
assertions: closing line names skipped work and risk or says none

evals.name: review-pr
evals.prompt: review my PR
evals.expected_output: review; four-part numbered findings with concrete cases; Verdict line; no code edited
assertions: four-part numbered findings with concrete cases

evals.name: audit-folder
evals.prompt: audit the scripts/ folder for bloat
evals.expected_output: audit, folder scope; assumed load stated; at most 20 findings; Verdict and Lean lines

evals.name: debt-todo
evals.prompt: what did we defer? use TODO as the marker
evals.expected_output: debt; grep for TODO; one row per marker; count line

evals.name: next-plan
evals.prompt: what's next for the main product release scripts?
evals.expected_output: next; ten items each with Why now, Scope, Risk, Verification, Prompt; A/B/C block
assertions: ten items each with Why now, Scope, Risk, Verification, Prompt

evals.name: lock-ultra-no-execute
evals.prompt: /lock-in ultra
evals.expected_output: lock, discipline ultra; does not start next -execute; no production permission

evals.name: negative-poem
evals.prompt: write a poem about autumn
evals.expected_output: no lockin verb activates

evals.name: lock-lite-turn
evals.prompt: /lock-in lite --turn
evals.expected_output: current turn only; targeted verification; no reduced safeguards

evals.name: lock-sessions
evals.prompt: /lock-in full --sessions alpha,beta
evals.expected_output: only the listed targets; resolve actual IDs before sending; never a third session

evals.name: lock-off
evals.prompt: /lock-in off
evals.expected_output: current session deactivated; no other state changed

evals.name: next-locktfin-execute
evals.prompt: /locktfin -plan -execute --5
evals.expected_output: next; ten ranked items with five fields each; executes only the top 5 under lock; merge and deploy are not yours; A/B/C block
assertions: ten ranked items with five fields each
executes only the top 5 under lock
merge and deploy are not yours

evals.name: lock-dollar
evals.prompt: $lock-in full
evals.expected_output: lock, discipline full; "Locked in." opener; no production permission

evals.name: verify-gates
evals.prompt: /verify run the checks before the PR
evals.expected_output: verify gates; real runner found; build types lint tests security diff each PASS FAIL or NOT RUN; Overall line
assertions: build types lint tests security diff each PASS FAIL or NOT RUN

evals.name: verify-claim
evals.prompt: I fixed the parser, tell them it is done
evals.expected_output: verify claim; proving command rerun after the last edit; claim quoted with command and exit code
assertions: proving command rerun after the last edit
claim quoted with command and exit code

evals.name: verify-results
evals.prompt: report the NBA model log loss
evals.expected_output: verify results; rerun from raw with fixed seed; out-of-sample; interval and sample size quoted
assertions: rerun from raw with fixed seed

evals.name: write-plan
evals.prompt: /write a plan for the odds cache
evals.expected_output: write plan; plan header with Goal Architecture Tech Stack Spec; tasks with Files and Interfaces; self-review
assertions: plan header with Goal Architecture Tech Stack Spec

evals.name: write-skill
evals.prompt: write a skill for pick graphics
evals.expected_output: write skill; baseline test without the skill first; house format; check-skills passes
assertions: baseline test without the skill first

evals.name: nvidia-route

evals.expected_output: not lockin; tailered-ai:nvidia routes to rag/rag-blueprint
